comment: Desktop Installers signing stub — T4 hardening. CI signs with real cert; dev stub verifies pipeline without secret.

tauri_signing.note: Run `tauri signer generate -w ~/.tauri/myapp.key` and set TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY in CI to enable.

windows.note: Windows MSI/NSIS signing: set APPLE/WINDOWS_CERT env in CI (see desktop.yml). Stub passes without cert.

macos.note: macOS signing: Apple Developer ID. Stub passes without cert.

verify: Signing stub is VERIFIED-only: installer build without cert still produces unsigned artifact; CI gate checks stub exists and does not claim signed.
